nba.label: NBA v2 · fatigue + 45-day form
nba.objective: Lowest error on the 2024-25 selection season; promoted only after beating Ridge v1 on 2025-26 holdout error and opening-to-closing line value
nba.sampleLabel: 1,322 NBA games · 2025-26 walk-forward holdout, daily refits, vs ESPN BET openers at -110
nba.scopeNote: Settings chosen on 2024-25 only; numbers shown are the untouched 2025-26 holdout. Still trails the market (holdout error 11.48 vs opener 11.21), so NBA picks stay leans until a bucket clears the publish bar. Applies only to games captured after activation.
nba.validationNote: Promoted over Ridge v1: holdout CLV +0.18 vs +0.12 pts, error 11.48 vs 11.57. Injury values priced at 0.31 pts per missing-player point; injuries showed no edge vs closing lines and no effect on totals.
